A '''library branch''' was located in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. It was operated by the [[Librarian droid/Legends|librarian droid]] [[Whrr]] and had only a slot in a door where [[Book/Legends|books]] and [[Hologame/Legends|hologames]] could be passed through.
